headline_item.title_zh: OpenAI发布儿童安全防护系统与图像分类器
headline_item.title_en: OpenAI announces tools to combat CSAM, including an image classifier and new warning screens to prevent users from accessing material that sexualizes children (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: OpenAI推出含AI图像分类器在内的一系列安全工具，旨在打击儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）并强化合规审核
headline_item.event_summary_en: OpenAI has partnered with the NCMEC and tech coalitions to launch an image classifier capable of detecting CSAM in AI-generated content, offering free API access to select partners. Simultaneously, ChatGPT has implemented warning screens and a 24-hour account suspension policy for violations, alongside new guidelines for developers and investigative tools for law enforcement agencies.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI、美国国家失踪与受虐儿童中心(NCMEC)、Tech Coalition、ROOST在ChatGPT交互界面与开发者生态系统：部署CSAM图像分类器、实施强制性预警与封禁策略、发布开发者合规指南及执法分析工具
【起因与机理】应对AI生成内容中日益增长的儿童性虐待材料安全隐患与监管压力
【核心事实细节】通过与非营利组织深度合作，建立行业级CSAM识别技术门槛。
【行业影响与走向】通过赋能执法部门与开发者，将安全合规从产品功能扩展至产业链监测能力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI, NCMEC, Tech Coalition, ROOST: Deployment of CSAM image classifier, mandatory warning/suspension systems, developer guidelines, and law enforcement support tools
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address safety risks and regulatory pressures concerning CSAM in AI-generated content
[Key Fact Detail] Establishing industry-level CSAM detection standards via partnerships with NPOs.
[Key Position & Outlook] Extending safety compliance to law enforcement and developer ecosystems.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此类举措标志着AI安全治理已从防御性内容过滤演进为主动式审查机制，试图通过输出端控制降低平台法律合规风险。分类器作为基础设施的开源/开放策略，意在通过建立行业统一的技术标准，将单一企业的安全压力转化为生态共治，以此规避日趋严格的生成式AI监管框架对平台责任的过度追究。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This initiative signals a shift in AI safety from passive filtering to proactive oversight, aimed at mitigating platform liability risks. By establishing the classifier as shared infrastructure, OpenAI seeks to standardize safety protocols across the ecosystem, effectively outsourcing compliance verification to shift the regulatory burden away from individual model providers.

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI CEO：AI产业具备长期增长惯性
headlines.title_en: Altman Says AI Industry ‘Will Be Fine’ After Huang’s Ouster
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI首席执行官山姆·奥特曼在旧金山公开表示，即便NVIDIA高层变动引起市场震荡，AI行业仍将凭借强劲的收入增长需求保持韧性
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated at a conference in San Francisco that the AI industry possesses the resilience to withstand market volatility following the departure of NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. Altman attributed this stability to strong underlying revenue growth and demand for AI compute, while acknowledging the pivotal visionary role Huang played in the industry's trajectory.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI首席执行官山姆·奥特曼：对NVIDIA高层人事变动及AI产业长期发展前景的公开表态
【起因与机理】回应市场对NVIDIA领导层更迭可能影响算力供应链稳定的担忧
【核心事实细节】核心观点：AI行业收入与需求的内生增长能力可抵消供应端人事风险。
【各方立场与态度】市场态势：试图平息算力供应端的恐慌情绪，维持产业估值稳定性。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI CEO Sam Altman: Public assessment of NVIDIA's leadership transition and long-term AI market viability
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing market anxieties regarding potential instability in the compute supply chain
[Market & Financial Detail] Core thesis: Internal revenue and demand growth outweigh supply-side leadership risks.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Market outlook: Efforts to dampen panic in the compute supply chain and maintain valuation stability.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 奥特曼的表态意在稳定AI供应链信心，旨在解耦算力硬件提供商的个别领导层变动与宏观算力需求增长。尽管NVIDIA在当前生态中具有极高的路径依赖性，但AI产业的资本投入惯性已形成闭环，即便核心供应端出现人事波动，短期内也难以逆转已规模化部署的算力基础设施增长周期。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Altman’s statement aims to stabilize confidence in the AI supply chain by decoupling compute growth from individual executive transitions. While NVIDIA currently represents a high-degree of path dependence, the capital investment momentum in the AI sector is already locked in, ensuring that the deployment cycle of compute infrastructure remains largely immune to near-term leadership volatility.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达董事会否决黄仁勋回归计划
headlines.title_en: Sources: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO and is focused on a national security investigation into Huang (CNBC)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达董事会明确否认考虑黄仁勋回归，目前重心集中于针对其个人的国家安全调查
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia's board officially denied rumors of rehiring Jensen Huang, stating that their primary focus remains on cooperating with a national security investigation into his conduct. Despite widespread public petitions for his reinstatement following his resignation over personal misconduct and compliance controversies, the board has commenced a formal search for a successor.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达董事会、前CEO黄仁勋：否认复职讨论，推进国家安全调查与高管猎聘
【起因与机理】因涉及个人私生活丑闻与潜在的合规与国家安全风险导致辞职
【核心事实细节】董事会否认黄仁勋复职的可能性。
【各方立场与态度】已启动全球猎头寻找新任首席执行官。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nvidia Board of Directors, former CEO Jensen Huang: Rejecting reinstatement, prioritizing security probes and executive search
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Resignation following personal conduct controversies and potential compliance/security risks
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Board rejects Jensen Huang's return.
[Key Position & Outlook] Global executive search initiated for a new CEO.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 黄仁勋的离职已从单纯的道德瑕疵事件演变为涉及地缘科技安全层面的机构合规危机。董事会的强硬态度反映出英伟达正在极力切割创始人个人风险，以应对潜在的出口管制审查与供应链信任评估，短期内该职位的权力真空将显著增加公司在AI芯片战略扩张中的不确定性。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Huang's departure has evolved from a moral lapse into an institutional compliance crisis involving geopolitical security. The board's stance indicates a deliberate effort to decouple the firm from founder-related risks to satisfy export control scrutiny and supply chain trust requirements, introducing significant leadership uncertainty during a critical phase of AI chip dominance.

从车辆从未捕捉到的视角查看录制的驾驶场景。

NVIDIA Research 的 LidarVerse 是第一个模拟不同 LiDAR 传感器扫描的模型，该传感器使用激光捕获 3D 环境。它可以从新的视点重新创建场景，从地图生成场景，并预测传感器接下来会看到什么，所有这些都是实时的。

titans.quote_en:
See a recorded driving scene from a viewpoint the vehicle never captured.

NVIDIA Research’s LidarVerse is the first model to simulate scans for different LiDAR sensors, which use lasers to capture surroundings in 3D. It can recreate scenes from new viewpoints, generate scenes from maps, and predict what a sensor will see next, all in real time.

Read the paper and get the code ➡️ https://t.co/mvaGUVMLjP
